reason: No proposal concerns logging. ~37 main files use loggerService.withContext; about a dozen non-vendored main files (NotificationService, CdpElectron, hiker utils, cms adapter workers) still call console.*.
No proposal concerns path access. There is no application.getPath API in the code; main code uses getSystemPath/getUserPath/getHomePath and path constants from @main/utils/path.
No proposal concerns this. app.getPath appears only inside the central path utility, os.homedir is never called; other code joins onto utility-provided base paths.
No proposal concerns imports of an application singleton. No @application alias or import exists anywhere in src/main.

D-238824 is about return types, not type location. Shared types live in src/renderer/src/types and src/shared/types, but many files (main services, schemas, renderer components/config) also export their own types.
No proposal concerns file naming. Only 39 of 96 renderer .vue/.tsx files are PascalCase; most are index.vue in kebab-case directories or kebab-case names.
No proposal concerns file naming. Hooks and utils are camelCase (one stream-decoder.ts exception), but main services are PascalCase (AppService.ts etc.).
No proposal concerns tests. All TS test files are *.test.ts inside __tests__/ subdirectories.
No proposal concerns logging. 35 main modules import loggerService from '@logger' and use withContext (one imports from '@main/services/LoggerService'); renderer modules log via console instead.
No proposal concerns logging. initWindowSource is defined but never called anywhere in the renderer.
No proposal concerns console use. console.* appears in ~44 renderer/shared/preload files and ~14 non-vendored main files.
No proposal concerns paths. 22 main files import from '@main/utils/path', often path constants (APP_DATABASE_PATH, HOME_BIN_PATH) rather than calling getUserPath/getSystemPath directly.
No proposal concerns the UI library. tdesign-vue-next is the only UI library; 77 .vue files use <t-*> components.

No proposal concerns preload. Preload exposes APIs via contextBridge with contextIsolation true / nodeIntegration false, but has a non-isolated fallback assigning to window and exposes electronAPI (ipcRenderer, process).
No proposal concerns IPC validation. Most of the ~65 ipcMain handlers pass inputs straight through (e.g. OPEN_PATH, PATH_JOIN, FS_DIR_CREATE); only a few check inputs.
No proposal concerns URL sanitization. strict-url-sanitise is not a dependency or imported anywhere; a custom isSecurityScheme check is used instead.
No proposal covers packages/vlc. The renderer bridge exposes Promise-based APIs over IPC, but the control-layer VlcApi wraps native calls synchronously.
No proposal covers Rust code. Global INSTANCES state is a once_cell::sync::Lazy<Mutex<...>>; only a std::sync::Once for macOS class registration differs.
No proposal covers Rust code. Event callbacks use napi ThreadsafeFunction called NonBlocking.
No proposal covers Rust code. No lock_state() exists; the equivalent helper lock_instances() is used for all global state access (36 call sites, INSTANCES.lock only inside it).
No proposal covers Rust code. There is no play_media; create() calls destroy() (which releases the old player via clear_player) before load_media creates a new one.
No proposal covers Rust code. All strings passed to libVLC (media paths, options, args, subtitle paths) go through CString.
No proposal covers Rust code. Events are delivered as VlcEventPayload via the threadsafe function.
No proposal covers Rust code. load_media uses libvlc_media_new_location for HTTP media and libvlc_media_new_path with normalize_media_path for local files.
No proposal covers Rust code. macOS window code lives in platform/macos.rs, but Windows/X11 window-handle code is inline in lib.rs attach().
No proposal covers packages/vlc. Main code (ipcMain) is in src/control exported as ./control, renderer code in src/renderer exported as ./renderer; no app consumers import it yet.
No proposal covers packages/vlc. All 14 files in player/ are <feature>Mix.ts.
No proposal concerns unused variables. Verifying requires running eslint.
No proposal concerns unused template variables. Verifying requires running eslint.
No proposal concerns import ordering. Sampled files follow simple-import-sort grouping and alphabetical order.
No proposal concerns export ordering. Sampled export-from lists are sorted.
No proposal concerns Vue templates. Template component tags are kebab-case; only one built-in <KeepAlive> uses PascalCase.
No proposal concerns emits. All emitted event names are kebab-case or update:<prop>.
No proposal concerns SFC structure. All 94 SFCs order template, script, style.
No proposal concerns SFC script lang. Every <script> block in the 94 SFCs declares lang ts or tsx.
No proposal concerns styles. Every <style> block in the SFCs is scoped.
No proposal concerns SFC layout. No SFC has a blank line before a top-level <script>/<style> block.

No proposal covers the crypto example. Sampled useCallback dependency arrays list all used values.
